retained_observation_adjudication.scope: This v2 clarifies only the F1 requested/actual-backend clause. All goal, fixtures, public actions, correctness and probability obligations, full-row/historical comparisons, scoring, trial/warmup counts/order, resource budgets, disclosure and evidence-breadth conditions remain unchanged. This is adjudication of the same original observations, not another T1 run and not carryover from a different acceptance.
eligibility: Before review, seal a path/byte-length/SHA256 inventory of the original raw artifacts and consumed evidence, with a completion record identifying when every original required action, comparison, report and evidence audit finished. Preserve the original spec/lock, original report and all artifacts unchanged. A seal can freeze existing completed observations; it cannot retrospectively attest to work whose original completion time is unproven.

Verify the original journey clock and completion record prove all unchanged requirements were actually observed/consumed within the original 60-minute deadline. No timer reset, budget extension, product edits, missing-output substitution or completion of previously missing work is allowed. If this prerequisite is unproven, retain INCOMPLETE; any independently established product failure remains FAIL.

Verify fixed fixture/oracle/historical pins and both original source identities, module paths, dependency/options and before/after source hashes. retained_observation_adjudication.reviewer: A fresh independent reviewer receives this locked v2, original input pins and the sealed raw observations, but no production source/diffs, implementation intent or prior verdict. The reviewer is a deterministic evidence consumer, not a second measured-worker executor.
protocol: Validate every inventory hash and evidence link before adjudication. Establish source/fixture identity, clock compliance, complete roster, warmup exclusion and serial scheduling from original raw manifests, commands and process observations. Write a new adjudication report with v1/v2 hashes, the sealed-inventory hash, source/input identities, original observation interval, review interval, criterion-by-criterion raw-evidence links and independently established findings. Do not describe this as a new timed benchmark or new live-use acceptance.
retained_observation_adjudication.no_new_workers: Zero product invocations, measured workers, warmups or retries during this clarification review. New public execution is not needed to decide what an unchanged already-observed backend field means. Existing complete observations remain the evidence; a fresh review adds independent adjudication only.
retained_observation_adjudication.deadline_interpretation: The original 60-minute deadline governs completion of every original required action, consumption, comparison and report. Administrative review of that completed record does not restart or extend the observation budget and cannot supply missing original observations. Record the independent review duration separately; do not relabel it as part of a new T1 execution.
retained_observation_adjudication.rationale: The ambiguity changes neither the public action nor its result: requested algorithm and actual backend were already emitted and preserved. A fresh independent deterministic review can resolve their contractual interpretation without rerunning 30 scored workers or changing measured populations. This route is defensible only after the eligibility prerequisites are independently verified.
